rationale: Round 4: parent is GPT-6 Luna + PDF + reasoning_effort='none' (aggregate 0.9807, latency median 12112ms, cost $0.002324/row); frontier best-so-far {accuracy=0.983, latency=12112, cost=$0.002324}. Need to improve latency by >1000ms (<11112ms) OR cost by >$0.0003 (<$0.002024) without accuracy regressing below 0.978. Flipping input_mode pdf→text (lever-probe: accepted on GPT-6 Luna with reasoning_effort='none') replaces the ~10-50KB PDF file-block (image-rendered to tokens on the backend) with a ~3-10KB pdftotext -layout string. Input tokens are the dominant cost line item on Luna at reasoning='none' (output <$0.0004/row of $0.00232); predicted cost drop $0.0005-0.0008/row (clears $0.0003 epsilon) and median latency drop 2-4s even after ~0.5s local pdftotext (clears 1000ms epsilon). Accuracy risk is bounded: the two fields that lose card-art visibility (field_cards_cardMeta_network at 0.000, field_cards_cardMeta_productFamily — excluded) can't go lower, cardAvailableCreditLimit/cardCreditLimit at 0.674 are numeric body-text fields text should actually improve, and the free-text fields (transactions_description 0.99, periodEnd/Start 1.0, dates) are text-native. Likely dip on cardDisplayName (0.888) and lastFourDigit (0.93), but their weight across 28 fields keeps the aggregate within the 0.005 floor. The current ZeroReasoningSavesageAgent reads self.input_mode as the default so the lever change propagates with no code edit — cleanest attribution, both latency AND cost predicted to clear independently.
